defects_found_and_repaired.description: 1024-d Qwen query vector passed to get_topk_similar resulting in GSQL-90000 and swallowed empty results.
defects_found_and_repaired.resolution: Repaired in 14D-R and verified in 14D-S test suite test_05: 1024-d query vectors route exclusively to GraphRAG_Hybrid_Qwen_Vector_Search operating on v.qwen_embedding (1024-d).

defects_found_and_repaired.description: Stale evaluator code in graphrag container due to unmounted benchmark/ directory.
defects_found_and_repaired.resolution: Added ./benchmark/:/code/benchmark volume mount to graphrag service in docker-compose.yml.

defects_found_and_repaired.description: Live runner evaluator path discrepancy between host and container.
defects_found_and_repaired.resolution: Configured runner to dynamically import unified_evaluator from /code/benchmark.

issues_deliberately_left_unchanged.reason: Audited in 14D-Q and verified in 14D-S. Structured output failures on provider side must NOT trigger recursive retries or LLM retry loops; existing bounded keyword fallback remains sole safe fallback path.
MAX_REPLANS=1, MAX_PLAN_RETRIES=2, MAX_LLM_CALLS_PER_QUESTION=6 are strictly enforced invariants and were deliberately left untouched.

structured_output.resilience: PydanticOutputParser with bounded keyword fallback in agentic_planner.py
